published_ranges._notes: Values from Kingroon's official multi-filament datasheet ('Kingroon Filament Guide', Filaments-Datasheet.pdf, row 'PA-CF': 250-280C / bed 50-70 / 1.24 g/cm3 / 153C(0.45MPa) / fan 100%). Diameter, drying, hardened-nozzle and enclosure guidance are not in any official Kingroon source read; the Amazon listing B0DQPDTD2Z (sold by third-party seller 'Hongshengqi', not confirmed as Kingroon's official store, so not used for fields) says 1.75mm +/-0.02mm, bed 70-100C, dry 60-70C 8-12h, print 250-280C at 30-60mm/s, enclosed printer + hardened steel nozzle. Carbon-fibre filled: treat as abrasive (hardened nozzle) and hygroscopic. kingroon.com page publishes no settings; kingroon3d.com PA-CF page shows PLA template values (190-210C) - ignored. Bambu Studio Kingroon preset not confirmed; parent is Bambu's own PA6-CF.
